cohort: 50 pregnant patients at a single tertiary care hospital in Coimbatore, India, enrolled between July 2021 and June 2023.
finding: Supraventricular tachycardia and ventricular premature complexes were the most common arrhythmias during pregnancy, occurring mainly in the third trimester, and most cases had good pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: 76% of cases had a vaginal delivery and 24% had a cesarean section.
birth_weight: One case of low birth weight was noted (2%).
